chunks: Easy have We made the Qur'an to understand: So is there any one who will be warned?

key_terms.مُدَّكِرٍ: One who takes heed or remembers

ai.seo_question: What does it mean that the Qur'an was made easy for dhikr?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the divine ease (Yasirna) of the Qur'an, affirming that its guidance is accessible to all who seek it, particularly through the lens of the Ahl al-Bayt's interpretive authority. The rhetorical question serves as a call to active contemplation (tadabbur), linking the text's clarity to the spiritual readiness of the listener. This highlights the balance between the Qur'an's inherent clarity and the human responsibility to internalize its lessons.
